plugins.name: swage/github
plugins.title: GitHub
plugins.description: Install repositories from GitHub accounts and organizations, with deploy keys and push-to-deploy webhooks.

plugins.name: swage/gitlab
plugins.title: GitLab
plugins.description: Install repositories from GitLab.com or a self-hosted GitLab, with deploy keys and push-to-deploy webhooks.

plugins.name: swage/laraowl
plugins.title: LaraOwl
plugins.description: Report requests, exceptions, queries and jobs from your sites to a LaraOwl monitoring server, configured from each site's settings.

plugins.name: swage/nightwatch
plugins.title: Nightwatch
plugins.description: Report your sites to Laravel Nightwatch, with an agent Swage runs and restarts for each site, configured from its settings.

plugins.name: swage/security-scanner
plugins.title: Security scanner
plugins.description: Scan each server's SSH, sudo and nginx logs for brute force attempts and probing, with alerts, firewall blocking and fail2ban.
